products.description:
Migrate Intune Android management to the Android Management API (AMAPI) cleanly

Microsoft is moving Intune Android Enterprise management from the legacy Play EMM API to the Android Management API (AMAPI) — and teams need to know the migration approach, the end-user impact, and whether devices re-enroll. This solution is the AMAPI migration playbook: assess your current Android estate and enrollment models, plan the wave, execute the migration (including the newer web / account-driven enrollment path), validate account add and app delivery, and handle the common post-migration failures — with every version-specific behavior verified against current Microsoft guidance, not assumed.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what AMAPI is, how it differs from the legacy Play EMM API, the enrollment methods affected (incl. web/account-driven), and the end-user / re-enrollment impact model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Android Enterprise, the managed Google Play binding, admin roles, a pilot fleet, endpoints).
  • Assessment & Migration Guide — inventory current management + enrollment models, plan the migration wave, execute (with the web/account-driven enrollment method), validate, and expand — pilot-first; re-enrollment and behavior flagged 'verify against current Microsoft guidance'.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (migrated devices manage under AMAPI, accounts add, apps deliver) plus Best Practices for a low-disruption migration and post-migration troubleshooting pointers.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Intune Android management moved to AMAPI with eyes open — the estate assessed, the wave planned, migration executed and validated, and end-user + re-enrollment impact understood — low-disruption and current.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AMAPIMIG-Assess-AndroidEstate.ps1 — inventory the Intune Android estate by enrollment model for AMAPI migration planning (read-only)
    • AMAPIMIG-Config.ps1 — shared config + managed Google Play binding health summary for the AMAPI migration (read-only)
    • AMAPIMIG-Get-PostMigrationValidation.ps1 — post-migration validation report for a wave cohort: devices check in, compliant, apps deliver, account/ownership signals (read-only)
    • AMAPIMIG-New-MigrationWavePlan.ps1 — bucket the Android estate into migration waves and (optionally) create the wave groups (safe: read-only unless -CreateGroups -Commit)
    • AMAPIMIG-Test-WebEnrollmentReadiness.ps1 — check prerequisite signals for web / account-driven Android enrollment (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
